overview.definition: QA summary has no batch-level QA_PASS and 511 products have MAJOR issues.
Fix only affected fields/products, then re-QA revised products. Do not rerun full catalog research.
Products with at least one MAJOR issue.
QA_REVISE without MAJOR; usually keyword evidence limitation or score below pass.
Still not APPROVED; complete admin/export and human approval prerequisites.
Content revision products grouped into max 10 products per revision batch.
Usually approval/deploy/evidence prerequisites, not all content rewrites.
Should be 0 for a reliable plan.
